_readme: Readings relayed into the cockpit when the build host cannot reach market data
providers directly. Claude writes this file during a refresh; you can also edit
it by hand. Run 'python3 -m cockpit inbox' to print a skeleton, then
Each entry may carry: value (required), change, change_pct, prev_close, open,
day_high, day_low, year_high, year_low, as_of, market_status, note, source_url.
Anything missing that can be reconstructed (a change from a percent, a previous
close from a change) is filled in at fetch time.

us10y.note: Relayed from a web search of tradingeconomics.com and ts2.tech; CNBC's quote service is unreachable from this build host.

us2y.note: Constant-maturity 2-year for August 2026 via tradingeconomics.com — a monthly reference figure, not an intraday print.

spx.note: Relayed from a web search of Yahoo Finance / Seeking Alpha closing data.

ndx.note: Relayed from a web search of Bloomingbit / Investing.com.

dax.note: Thursday's Xetra close — Friday's DAX print was not yet published when this was relayed.

vix.note: Relayed from a web search of CNBC / Investing.com.

gold.note: Spot gold per troy ounce, relayed from tradingeconomics.com — the configured tile tracks the front-month future, which trades a little away from spot.

btc.note: Relayed from CoinDesk. A second source quoted roughly $75,300 the same morning — crypto prints vary by venue.
